_comment: Ticket 31 golden set: fictional mail that no reader accepted (no attachment, or none DW1 reads), with the kind a person would give it. Senders are the mock customers' domains; every name, number and story is invented. `regex_miss` marks a phrasing the keyword tables route elsewhere.
